Your model and your node

Route to a model you host yourself, and the status of renting capacity to others.

A workspace can register a model it runs itself as an upstream. The router probes it, lists it in GET /v1/models with ownedBy: workspace, and routes to it like any other candidate; the request fee applies to such traffic as described in the BYOK chapter, with the same free allowance.

A person with spare capacity can list a node. The router schedules work to listed nodes and records what each node earned (NODE-1). The earnings are read in the console; paying them out is a console action, not a public door.

Registering and listing are console actions today. A public door for them is not part of this contract.
